evidence.name: Screen field: Space inside the field
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space inside the field" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space inside the field
sections.description: Sets the breathing room between the text or icon and the field's edges, on the top, right, bottom, and left. Generous spacing makes the field a bigger, easier tap target and keeps text from crowding the outline. If the field feels cramped on a phone, increase the top and bottom spacing.
